memories.content: Petra is a senior colorist currently employed elsewhere and is happily employed. She has no prior relationship with the recruiter or Torchlight Media. She may or may not check messages from unknown senders.

The recruiter can send a message to Petra via a professional networking platform or email, and Petra can reply through the same channel. The message is a first-contact inquiry about an opening at Torchlight Media.
